c74object.name: el.player~
c74object.description:
el.player~ is a polyphonic, click-triggered audio buffer player with sample-accurate voice allocation. Each incoming non-zero click in the left inlet spawns a new playback voice whose gain is scaled by the trigger sample's amplitude. The object supports polyphony up to 128 overlapping voices with automatic voice stealing. Playback speed and pitch are determined by the increment factor in the right inlet. Through the static_increment attribute, the increment can either be latched at trigger onset per voice (static mode) or modulated continuously across all active voices in real time (dynamic mode). Negative increments play the buffer in reverse.
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (signal / messages): Click trigger and gain input, and control message inlet (setbuf, stop, mute). Any non-zero sample initiates a playback voice scaled by the click amplitude.
Inlet 2 [Right Inlet] (signal / float): Playback increment / pitch factor (1.0 = normal speed, 2.0 = octave up, -1.0 = reverse).
Outlets
Outlets 1 to N (signal): Audio signal outputs (1 to 4 channels, determined by the second argument, default: 2). Multi-channel buffers are mapped across these outlets.

inlet.digest: (signal/messages) Click trigger and gain / control commands
inlet.description: Any non-zero audio sample triggers a new playback voice with amplitude scaled to the trigger value. Also accepts control messages (setbuf, stop, mute).
Sets the playback speed and direction multiplier (1.0 = normal, 2.0 = double speed / octave up, -1.0 = reverse). Accepts float messages or audio-rate signals.

outlet.description: Subsequent audio output channels (up to 4 channels).

objarg.name: buffer-name
objarg.description: Required. The name of the buffer~ to read from.

objarg.name: channel-count
objarg.description: The number of audio signal outlets to create (default: 2, range: 1 to 4).

objarg.name: maximum-overlaps
objarg.description: The maximum number of simultaneous overlapping playback voices allowed (default: 8, range: 1 to 128). If all voices are busy when a new trigger arrives, the oldest voice closest to completion is stolen.

method.name: float
method.description: Sets the user playback increment when sent to inlet 2 (zero values are rejected).

method.name: mute
method.description: When set to 1, mutes DSP computation and outputs silence. When set to 0 (default), normal playback resumes.

method.name: setbuf
method.description: Reassigns the target buffer~ by name and immediately halts all currently active voices.

method.name: stop
method.description: Immediately stops all currently playing playback voices and resets their playheads.

method.name: signal
method.description: Non-zero samples arriving at inlet 1 trigger new playback voices. Signal connected to inlet 2 continuously modulates the playback increment at audio rate.

attribute.name: static_increment
attribute.description: When set to 1 (On), each voice latches the active increment value at the instant of the click trigger and keeps it constant for the duration of the note. When set to 0 (Off, default), changes to the increment input modulate the pitch and speed of all active notes simultaneously.
